name: pipeline-maker-taker
description: Single LONG round trip with a maker/taker fee model (makerRate 0.0005, takerRate 0.002), same funding and prices as pipeline-long-roundtrip-fees.json (all-in buy@100, sell@110). Both legs are plain market fills and a market fill always takes liquidity, so BOTH sides are charged the TAKER rate (0.002), never the MAKER rate (0.0005); the maker rate only applies to resting limit fills (see pipeline-limit-fill.json). This pins that a market fill routes through the fee model as taker: a bug that mis-routed market fills as maker would land feeBase 0.005, feeQuote 0.549725 and output 1098.900275 instead of the canonical numbers below. Derivation (all-in base = 1000/100 = 10, RECEIVED leg, rate 0.002 on both sides since both are TAKER): buy feeBase = 10*0.002 = 0.02, baseNet = 9.98; sell quoteGross = 9.98*110 = 1097.8, feeQuote = 1097.8*0.002 = 2.1956, quoteNet = 1097.8 - 2.1956 = 1095.6044.
